{
   name         max_slots_per_user
   description  "Fair use: no single user takes more than 24 slots"
   enabled      TRUE
   limit        users {*} to slots=24
}
{
   name         license_limits
   description  "Finance gets a capped share of the MATLAB pool"
   enabled      TRUE
   limit        projects finance to matlab=5
   limit        users {*} to ansys=4
}
{
   name         gpu_per_user
   description  "At most two GPUs per user"
   enabled      TRUE
   limit        users {*} queues gpu.q to gpu=2
}
